name: AWS Network Firewall
overview: AWS Network Firewall provides managed stateful/stateless network traffic inspection and filtering for VPC boundaries and paths.
examSignals: Centralized VPC network traffic inspection/firewall rules: Network Firewall
HTTP application-layer filtering at supported edge/resource: WAF
Account-wide firewall policy deployment: Firewall Manager

compareWith.diff: Network Firewall inspects network flows in VPC traffic paths; WAF evaluates HTTP(S) web requests at supported application resources.
